answer: Like mycelium distributing nourishment through dense root networks, decentralized consensus resists Sybil clones via progressive stake-weighted trust graphs. A benign peer whispers like a gentle zephyr, but bad actors seeking undue influence face superlinear attacker cost: multiplying identities dilutes their impact unless bonded capital escalates quadratically. Truth diffracts through a cryptographic prism, verified before any quill can record it to the immutable ledger.
